component.name: Jellyfin Client Lite
component.summary: Tiny terminal music player for your Jellyfin library

description.p: Start it and it shuffles your whole Jellyfin music library in the terminal. Playback is done by mpv and the files are streamed as they are, without transcoding, so it stays light on your PC and your server.
Starten, und es spielt deine ganze Jellyfin-Musikbibliothek zufällig im Terminal ab. Die Wiedergabe übernimmt mpv, die Dateien kommen unverändert ohne Umwandeln, das schont PC und Server.

ul.li: Media keys and the desktop media widget work (with mpv-mpris)
Medientasten und das Medien-Widget des Desktops funktionieren (mit mpv-mpris)
Search, album view, cover art and lyrics from your server
Suche, Album-Ansicht, Cover und Songtexte vom Server
Tells your server what is playing, so play counts and statistics stay up to date
Meldet dem Server, was läuft – Wiedergabezahlen und Statistik bleiben aktuell
Optionally shows what you are listening to in Discord
Zeigt auf Wunsch in Discord an, was du hörst

screenshot.caption: Shuffling a library, with the queue and lyrics on the side

description.p: Reports playback to the Jellyfin server, installs an APT source for automatic updates, and is now licensed under Apache-2.0.
